description: A single-panel figure rendered as a table (no plot, micrograph or scale bar) with four column headers: "Alloy", "Heat treatment temperature", "Composition of B2 (in wt. %)" and "Composition of B2 (in at. %)". It reports TEM-EDS point analyses of B2 particles, with the caption noting the balance is Fe. Two alloys appear: 28Mn5Ni with three conditions (973 K, 1173 K (Particle-1), 1173 K (Particle-2)) and 15Mn5Ni with two (1173 K (Particle-1), 1173 K (Particle-2)); the 15Mn5Ni alloy has no 973 K row. Each condition lists Mn, Al and Ni in wt.% and in at.%. For 28Mn5Ni the B2 composition is nearly invariant with heat-treatment temperature: Mn 16.3–15.4 wt.%, Al 12.7–14.8 wt.%, Ni 24.6–27.5 wt.% (Mn 14.7–13.7 at.%, Al 23.3–26.7 at.%, Ni 20.8–22.8 at.%). The Mn-lean 15Mn5Ni alloy shows clearly lower Mn and Ni in B2 (Mn 10.5–8.7 wt.%, Ni 20.2–22.0 wt.%) with Al similar (12.8–13.5 wt.%). In every row the at.% value of Al is far higher than its wt.% value (Al is light), while Mn and Ni at.% values are lower than their wt.% values. Fe is not tabulated numerically.

subfigures.description: A four-column table of TEM-EDS B2-particle compositions for alloys 28Mn5Ni (973 K, 1173 K Particle-1, 1173 K Particle-2) and 15Mn5Ni (1173 K Particle-1, 1173 K Particle-2), giving Mn, Al and Ni in wt.% and at.%; Fe is the balance but is not listed as a number.

observations.observation: The table has four columns: 'Alloy', 'Heat treatment temperature', 'Composition of B2 (in wt. %)' and 'Composition of B2 (in at. %)'.
For 28Mn5Ni heat-treated at 973 K the B2 composition is Mn:16.3, Al:12.7, Ni:24.6 wt.% (Mn:14.7, Al:23.3, Ni:20.8 at.%).
For 28Mn5Ni heat-treated at 1173 K (Particle-1) the B2 composition is Mn:16.5, Al:14.2, Ni:26.1 wt.% (Mn:14.9, Al:25.7, Ni:21.8 at.%).
For 28Mn5Ni heat-treated at 1173 K (Particle-2) the B2 composition is Mn:15.4, Al:14.8, Ni:27.5 wt.% (Mn:13.7, Al:26.7, Ni:22.8 at.%).
For 15Mn5Ni heat-treated at 1173 K (Particle-1) the B2 composition is Mn:10.5, Al:12.8, Ni:20.2 wt.% (Mn:9.5, Al:23.5, Ni:17.0 at.%).
For 15Mn5Ni heat-treated at 1173 K (Particle-2) the B2 composition is Mn:8.7, Al:13.5, Ni:22.0 wt.% (Mn:7.8, Al:24.6, Ni:18.5 at.%).
No row exists for 15Mn5Ni at 973 K; only the 28Mn5Ni alloy has a 973 K entry.
In every row the Al at.% value is much larger than its wt.% value (e.g. 12.7 wt.% vs 23.3 at.% for 28Mn5Ni at 973 K), whereas Mn and Ni at.% values are lower than their wt.% values.
The B2 particles in 15Mn5Ni contain markedly less Mn and Ni than those in 28Mn5Ni at the same 1173 K heat treatment, while Al contents are comparable.
The caption states the elemental composition analysis was obtained by TEM-EDS for B2 particles in two LDS alloys in two different heat-treated conditions.
The caption notes that 'the balance is Fe content', but no Fe value is printed anywhere in the table.
No error bars, standard deviations or number of analysed points are given for any composition entry.
